summary: Statehood advocates say recent midterm results have created new momentum for DC statehood, while DC Vote has documented nine recent attacks on the District's local authority and outlined the current state of the fight for representation. Advocates also point to DC's population size as relevant to statehood discussions. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no senators, and their one delegate to the House cannot vote on the House floor.
